intro.text: The @ sign is used in every email address. On a UK keyboard it is Shift and apostrophe; on a US keyboard it is Shift and 2. The # (hash) is a key of its own on UK keyboards, and Shift and 3 on US keyboards.
intro.tip: Follow the on-screen keyboard – it shows exactly where each symbol is on your layout.

steps.title: Meet @ and #
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.
